## SimulationCall interface

Per-transaction normalized output from the simulation backend.

`SimulationResult.calls[i]` corresponds 1:1 with `SimulationResult.simulationTxs[i]`<!-- -->. Use this to read raw logs, status, return data, and gas used. Net asset changes are reported at the bundle level — see `SimulationResult.assetChanges`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface SimulationCall
```
